text:
matt: Heads up — canary running int8-quant build shows latency regression after merge 9a7c2d. p50 from 28ms -> 33ms (+18%), p99 up ~40% on 8k token long-context suite. Anyone on call? :eyes:

ci-bot: perf/regression/quant-int8-longctx FAILED
```
baseline: 28.0ms
current: 33.1ms
delta: +5.1ms (+17.9%)
p99 baseline: 210ms
p99 current: 295ms (+40.4%)
```

anya: ack. do we have a suspect range? any recent kernel selector or batching changes?

diego: i'll run a quick git-bisect. suspected range: merge PR 9a7c2d..HEAD. give me 20-30m.

diego: bisect complete — culprit: commit 9f1bca3 (runtime: prefer vNNI-friendly kernels for dequant route). It changed kernel selection heuristics and touched batching heuristics.
```
git show --name-only 9f1bca3
 runtime/kernel_selector.py
 runtime/batching/heuristics.py
```

julia: profiling snippet from an instrumented canary on the regressed build:
```
Top callers by cpu seconds:
  28.4%  dequant_kernel_copy_in
  17.2%  dequant_dispatch_overhead
  12.7%  kv_cache_lookup_ms (misses up 3.5x)
   9.6%  dynamic_batch_coalesce
```

julia: kv cache miss rate increase seems correlated with the batching heuristic change — smaller batches caused more cache churn and more dequant copies.

sam: quick mitigation — we've got a runtime flag `runtime.force_old_dequant=true` that reverts the kernel selector logic. can someone prod a canary with that env var?

matt: @diego can you deploy canary with the flag and run long-context suite? If it returns to baseline we'll cut a revert.

diego: deploying now, kicked off perf run: `./scripts/canary_run.sh --env RUNTIME_FLAGS=force_old_dequant=true`

ci-bot: canary perf job queued (job id: 78291). will post results here.

ci-bot: canary perf results:
```
baseline: 28.0ms
current: 27.9ms
delta: -0.1ms (-0.4%)
p99 baseline: 210ms
p99 current: 212ms (+0.9%)
```

matt: OK that's convincing. opening revert PR now: #4126 — reverts 9f1bca3 kernel selection tweak. cc: @julia @diego

anya: nice work team :thumbsup:

perf-bot: regression gate cleared, rollback scheduled for next maintenance window.

matt: will also add follow-up issue to redesign batching heuristic + add unit perf test for kv-cache churn.
